text: {"lessons":["I made no trades, so I should not mistake short-term account movements for evidence that any trading decision worked or failed.","Because prices move randomly, recent gains and losses do not tell me what prices will do next; I should avoid reacting to them alone.","I should review my holdings and risk against my long-term plan, while resisting the urge to hold just to avoid admitting a loss or sell merely to lock in a gain."]}
